cases.name: the decision model's question and how its answers are read

intent.instructions: A customer wrote this WhatsApp message to a small food shop (tiffin, bakery or catering) that takes pre-orders with an advance payment, in Hindi, English, Malayalam or Kannada (in their own script or in Latin letters). What does the customer want?

criteria.order: wants to order something, or asks what is available, or asks for a price or a day
criteria.paid: says they have already paid the advance
criteria.owner: asks to talk to the owner or to a person

cases.name: the system prompt
